_about: Everything on the Churrasco tab. Edit and push. Text can use **bold** and *italic*. Step photos go in content/churrasco/steps/step-<number>.jpg (or .png/.webp); a step without one shows 'Photo coming soon' on the site and nothing in the PDF. The Pope's portrait is content/churrasco/pope-deo.jpg.
_poundsGrilled: 10+ years x ~15 churrascos a year x ~4 lb each = 600 lb, plus 50 lb for the bigger cookouts.
_poundsPerCow: Take-home (boneless, trimmed) beef from one ~1,200 lb steer is about 480-570 lb; 500 lb is the extension services' rule of thumb. Sources: University of Wisconsin Extension (1,200 lb steer -> 481 lb), Nebraska Extension (1,400 lb steer -> 570 lb), UT Extension (1,200 lb steer -> ~500 lb).

decree.title: A Papal Decree
decree.text: Hear ye, hear ye! All are welcome unto the Holy Church of Churrasco, save those who eateth their steak **well done**. Such heathens shall burn in the most fiery of fires, in the deepest pits of Vegetation Hell.

hierarchy.title: The Holy Order
hierarchy.intro: Thus is the Church arranged, from the Throne of Embers down unto the faithful.

levels.title: Pope Deo
levels.subtitle: Supreme Pontiff of the Grill
levels.text: Keeper of the Sacred Salt and of the secret ways of the Touch.
levels.imageAlt: Pope Deo in green and gold papal robes and mitre, holding a golden staff, seated on a throne of swords before a churrasco grill full of skewers

levels.title: Cardinals of the Touch
levels.subtitle: Trained by the Pope's own hand
levels.text: They need no thermometer. By touch alone they know when the meat is just right, and their word is law at any grill.

levels.title: Bishops of the Thermometer
levels.subtitle: Walkers of the Sacred Steps
levels.text: Faithful servants who yet lean upon the thermometer, but who follow the steps and strive to forsake all sauce.

levels.title: Churrasco Fanatics & Worshipers
levels.subtitle: Spreaders of the Faith
levels.text: They love churrasco most of all and spread the word far and wide, yet have not truly learned the ways of the art. Great is their zeal; long is their path.

scripture.title: The Sacred Scripture of Churrasco
scripture.subtitle: The Holy Rite, in Eight Steps

steps.title: Procure the Sacred Salt
text: Get thyself churrasco salt: iodized, in big rocky chunks, and imported from Brazil if thou canst. Heathens have tried to cheap out with Himalayan salt and paid the price with a ruined steak.

The Church's top recommendations are **Sal Lebre** and **Mariza Churrasco D'Chef**, for their consistency and their quality held steady over the years. Seasoned churrasco salt is permitted by the Church, but not every brand, for some add too much, and simplicity is at the core of our faith.
**Aji-Sal** from Ajinomoto is also acceptable: its added MSG puts a spin on the flavor, and it makes a worthy interlude between the traditional saltings.

steps.title: Choose Thy Cut
text: The true churrasco is **picanha** roasted on the *espeto*, the sword-like skewer, upon a *churrasqueira giratória*, the wall-style grill that turns the meat without rest.

Yet the Church holds that churrasco must be a treat for the masses, and so we commend the **New York strip**, the **ribeye**, or the **top sirloin** (if thou preferest lean), cut **1 to 1½ inches** thick. At 2 inches or more the salt loses much of its power, and the longer time upon the fire harms the taste.

steps.title: Prepare the Altar and Anoint the Meat
text: Preheat the grill to **350°F**. Let the meat thaw for 10 minutes before thou tappest on the salt, and spread the salt evenly, by hand as is preferred.
It is against the laws of the Church to waste salt: once it has left the bag and touched the meat, it shall not serve another batch. Pour with care.
Put the meat on the grill soon after salting it. Let it not sit, nor marinate.

steps.title: Endure the Fire
text: Grill for about **7 minutes**, then flip. Then grill for another **7 minutes**.

steps.title: Judge the Meat
text: If thou art a **Cardinal of the Touch**, thou shalt know when the meat is done by touch alone. Otherwise, use the thermometer.
Instructions for the touch method shall not be given here. Those are secret texts, passed directly from the Pope to his most trusted inner circle.

steps.title: The Farofa
text: If thou hast farofa for churrasco, thou mayest use it to enhance the taste, but eat it not with every bite. Like the ginger beside the sushi, farofa is taken every few bites to refresh thy taste buds.
The recommended brand is **Yoki**, for it has delivered consistent results for many years.

steps.title: Give Thanks
text: Praise the source of the beef thou art eating. Thank the soul that was given for thy enjoyment and for thy nourishment.

steps.title: Rest Thy Soul
text: Rest thy soul as the meat sweats take over thy body.
